title: Flávio Bolsonaro Visits Father in House Arrest and Gains Support in São Paulo
seoTitle: Flávio Visits Father and Gains Support in SP
subtitle: PL presidential candidate meets Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília and receives demonstrations of support in São Paulo
excerpt: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL's candidate, made his first visit to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, and received backing in São Paulo.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Flávio Bolsonaro, the Liberal Party's presidential candidate, made his first visit on Tuesday morning (13) to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest in Brasília.

The meeting marked the first time father and son have seen each other since Jair Bolsonaro began serving his house arrest measure.

At the same time, Flávio Bolsonaro received expressions of support in São Paulo, according to available information.

With information from Agência Brasil.
